title: Integrated multimodal cell atlas of Alzheimer's disease
abstract: Integrated multimodal cell atlas of Alzheimer's disease covering 84 donors with RNA+ATAC+MERFISH profiling across AD progression.
findings: Multimodal atlas of AD progression across 84 donors, linking gene expression, chromatin accessibility, and spatial transcriptomics.

title: Single-cell multiregion dissection of Alzheimer's disease
authors: Mathys, H; Tsai, L-H et al.
abstract: Single-cell multiregion dissection of Alzheimer's disease across 1.3M cells from 6 brain regions, revealing regional vulnerability patterns.
findings: 1.3M cells across 6 brain regions reveal region-specific vulnerability in AD.

title: Single-cell atlas reveals correlates of high cognitive function, dementia, and resilience to AD pathology
authors: Mathys, H; Tsai, L-H et al.
abstract: Large-scale single-cell atlas of 2.3M cells from 427 donors, identifying biomarkers of cognitive resilience to AD pathology.
findings: 2.3M cells from 427 donors identify cellular correlates of resilience to AD pathology.

title: A high-resolution transcriptomic and spatial atlas of cell types in the whole mouse brain
authors: Yao, Z; Zeng, H et al.
abstract: 7M scRNA-seq + 4.3M MERFISH cells mapped to 5,322 clusters across the whole mouse brain, establishing a comprehensive reference atlas.
findings: Whole mouse brain atlas: 5,322 cell type clusters from 7M scRNA + 4.3M MERFISH cells.

title: A comparative atlas of single-cell chromatin accessibility in the human brain
abstract: 1.1M cells across 42 brain regions profiled by single-cell ATAC-seq, mapping regulatory elements across the human brain.
findings: 1.1M cells, 42 regions mapped by chromatin accessibility. Identifies regulatory elements across human brain.

title: Single-cell transcriptomic analysis of Alzheimer's disease
authors: Mathys, H; Tsai, L-H et al.
abstract: 80,660 single-nucleus transcriptomes from the prefrontal cortex of individuals with varying degrees of AD pathology.
findings: First single-cell atlas of early AD in prefrontal cortex (80,660 cells).

title: Transcriptomic diversity of cell types across the adult human brain
authors: Siletti, K; Linnarsson, S et al.
abstract: Over 3M cells from ~100 brain regions, identifying 3,313 subclusters across the adult human brain.
findings: 3M+ cells, ~100 regions, 3,313 subclusters. Most comprehensive human brain cell type atlas.

title: Molecular architecture of the developing mouse brain
authors: La Manno, G; Linnarsson, S et al.
abstract: Developmental atlas mapping ~800 cellular states from gastrulation to birth in mouse brain.
findings: ~800 cellular states mapped across mouse brain development, gastrulation to birth.

title: A brain cell atlas integrating single-cell transcriptomes across human brain regions
abstract: Meta-analysis integrating 26.3M cells from 70 studies across human brain regions.
findings: 26.3M cells from 70 studies integrated into a unified human brain cell atlas.
